description: This script processes footprint data, parses JSON files, interacts with a Git repository and InfluxDB, and generates reports or uploads data to a database.

methods.name: create_event
methods.description: Creates and writes footprint data points to InfluxDB with provided metadata.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for data directory, dry run flag, zephyr base, and JSON file.

methods.name: parse_file
methods.description: Parses a JSON footprint file, imports symbols into a tree structure, and extracts size data.

methods.name: process_files
methods.description: Processes footprint JSON files in a directory, interacts with Git and InfluxDB, and optionally uploads data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that orchestrates argument parsing and processing based on provided inputs.
